title: Separation of remote chart parameters by properness and injectivity
statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝᵐ be an arbitrary set, let W ⊆ ℝ^N be an open set, and let φ : ℝᵐ → ℝ^N be continuous on V and injective on V. Let v₀ ∈ V with φ(v₀) ∈ W, and assume that V ∩ φ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W. Then for every δ > 0 there is ε > 0 such that ε ≤ ‖φ(v) − φ(v₀)‖ for every v ∈ V with δ ≤ ‖v − v₀‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn m)) (W : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (φ : Rn m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (v₀ : Rn m), IsOpen W → ContinuousOn φ V → InjOn φ V → v₀ ∈ V → φ v₀ ∈ W → (∀ K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → IsCompact (V ∩ φ ⁻¹' K)) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ v ∈ V, δ ≤ ‖v - v₀‖ → ε ≤ ‖φ v - φ v₀‖
